claim: Swiss voters approve the amendment to the War Material Act in the federal vote on Sunday 29 November 2026.

runs.scenario: Before 23:59:00 the FSO dashboard shows a partial national total with more yes than no, while the completed provisional total—released by the Chancellery after 23:59:00, or a conflicting figure on the other named official page—has no votes equal to or ahead of yes. The criterion gives the two official sources no priority and does not say whether an incomplete same-day tally is already the resolving provisional result, so one reader counts the in-window partial YES and the other treats the later or conflicting complete figure, or the window cutoff, as NO.
